# Field note structure

- Open with the symptom, quoted from a real log line.
- State the first hypothesis and how it died. The wrong turns are the content.
- Show the disassembly, backtrace, or diff that changed your mind.
- Name the tool and version used.
- End with what is still broken. Don't resolve the story if it isn't resolved.
